leaders.name: Prof. Kenechi Anderson Uwakwe
leaders.summary: Biography, education, professional experience and research profile of Prof. Kenechi Anderson Uwakwe.
biography: Prof. Kenechi Anderson Uwakwe hails from the Umuezemma royal family of Opuoma in Ohaji/Egbema Local Government Area of Imo State. He was born into the family of HRH Eze W. A. C. Uwakwe and the late HRH Ugoeze H. N. Uwakwe.
He has professional experience across the public and private sectors and has served as the head or a member of committees in different institutions and professional bodies.
leaders.education: He attended Community Primary School, Ilupeju, Lagos, and Federal Government College, Okigwe. He obtained his MBBS from Abia State University, Uturu, and completed postgraduate residency training.
leaders.experience: He has worked in consulting and research capacities for organisations including NACA, UNFPA, the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, WHO, UNICEF, IMPRINT, GLRA, IHVN, CCCRN and CARITAS. He has served as an examiner at undergraduate institutions and as a member of postgraduate and undergraduate accreditation teams appointed by regulatory agencies within and outside Nigeria.
leaders.research: His research interest is epidemiology, particularly the epidemiology of communicable diseases. He has authored more than ninety peer-reviewed articles.

meta.source: Biography supplied for IMSUTH website publication
